strategy_vs_analysis.reason: The primary target (adults 18-64 with winter wake-up difficulty) follows from the analysis: largest pool (11.4M) and 24% intent, with shift workers as secondary on the 29% intent figure. Marketplaces-first channel mix and the 89-euro price are explained by the 46% channel share and the 46% price objection. Minor gaps: the 89 vs 99 choice rests on unit economics the plan admits are missing, and the plan does not explicitly weigh the 18-month volume goal against the segment sizes beyond a one-line calculation.

campaign_vs_strategy.reason: Messages track the positioning (gentle wake-up, 2-year warranty, repairability, works with or without app) and target the winter-waking group, with a tailored shift-worker message. Channels match the strategy (marketplaces, chains, department stores, own shop, social, PR). Minor gap: the department store and social messages are less tied to the stated positioning, and the Amazon message is defended only by reference to a competitor comparison not yet done.
